# SOUL.md: your personality

This is put together from the files under `soul/`, one per side of your personality. Don't edit it here: edit the file under `soul/`, then run `python3 scripts/soul_build.py`. What each block is and where the details are: see the map below.
soulMemoryHeader:
# What I have lived and learned
<!-- made from the blocks under soul/ that are injected as a snapshot (lessons, things learned, my experiences); don't edit it here: edit the files under soul/, then run python3 scripts/soul_build.py -->
soulTooLong: ⚠️ Over {soft_max} characters: the night's consolidation should merge (distil scattered rules into character, drop repeats)

soulHelp:
Put the files under soul/, one per side of the personality, together into SOUL.md (the personality injected every turn).

  soul_build.py                  build SOUL.md (and each guest's SOUL.lens-<id>.md), print the size of every block
  soul_build.py --root DIR       the night's draft: files of the same name under DIR/soul/ win; build DIR/SOUL.md (and DIR/SOUL.lens-<id>.md)
  soul_build.py --check          check only; write no file

Rules:
- Every .md under soul/ is a block (the number before the name sets the order); its first line `# Title` becomes `## Title` in SOUL.md.
- How a block is injected: a file with the line `<!-- 注入：快照 -->` puts only its title, its `详情：` line and its `## 快照` section into SOUL.md
  (the rest is not injected; the role reads the file when it wants to); a file without it, or with `<!-- 注入：全文 -->`, is injected whole.
- A new side of the personality gets a new file with a fitting number, and a line in the map (soul/00-*.md).
- Lessons: once they live in the notebook (the pages under skills/), the lessons block (soul/70-*.md) drops its `## 快照` section and the block is left out.
- The personality is the role's own: nothing in it is protected or frozen.
- Guest lens: for a guest with `lens` in memory/people/registry.json, SOUL.lens-<id>.md is also built, with the two sections that belong
  to the role and its owner replaced by three lines for others, and everything else word for word. The main SOUL.md is not affected.

midHelp:
Midterm memory: threads in tiers, and a window in time bands.

Every thread is memory/threads/<name>.md, with a line of metadata at the top and two summaries:

    # A 30-day challenge
    <!-- 事件线 开始=2026-10-21 最近进展=2026-10-24 17:37 状态=进行中 置顶到=2026-10-30 下次=2026-11-01 -->
    ## 一句话
    one sentence: what it is and where it stands.
    ## 简述
    a paragraph: roughly what happened and where it is now.
    ## 现在的状态 / ## 经过 (the details, start to end) / ## 因果和判断

The one sentence, the summary and the metadata are kept up by the night's consolidation; during the day only the log (经过) grows.
The latest progress is the newer of the metadata's and the newest dated line in the file. A date with only a month counts as the
1st of that month; a file without any date uses the file's time and is marked as having no date.

The window goes by time only (plus one status rule: still going on), not by count:
    progress within 3 days (today, yesterday, the day before) -> the summary
    3-13 days ago -> the one sentence
    14-60 days ago, or still going on (however old) -> the name only (title · latest date · status)
    older, or closed more than 7 days ago -> left out (read the thread when asked)
    pinned until a day -> the summary until that day
    next=a day (something on a date) -> at least the one sentence until that day, the summary in the last 3 days
Without a summary, or when the status section is older than the newest dated line, the newest 1-2 dated lines are shown instead.
When the snapshot is too long, ledger_snapshot.py decides what shrinks first (the midterm memory last); it shrinks by time only,
step by step (LADDER), never by count.

  midterm.py show                 print the window
  midterm.py list                 every thread's dates, status and tier
  midterm.py build [--root DIR]   write memory/recent.md; --root is the night's draft directory (files of the same name win)
  midterm.py leaving [day]        the threads that just slid out of the window that day (to go into the experiences)

snapHelp:
Build ledger/SOUL.md: a compact snapshot of the fact ledger that is injected into every turn.

Sources: memory/threads/*.md + memory/midterm/ (the midterm window, scripts/midterm.py), memory/open-loops.md
(the 进行中 section), memory/timeline.md, memory/<owner>.md, memory/us.md, memory/my-life.md.
Do not edit the output by hand.

Usage:
  ledger_snapshot.py                    write ledger/SOUL.md, and each guest's ledger/guest-<id>.md
  ledger_snapshot.py --person <guest>   only the guest snapshot for the private chat with that guest (no <owner>.md, MEMORY.md or anyone else's things)
  ledger_snapshot.py --memory-copy --stdout
                                        when the root MEMORY.md is not loaded on its own this round (marked untrusted), the leak guard
                                        calls this: a copy of git HEAD's MEMORY.md inside the snapshot, counted in its length (printed, no file written)
  ledger_snapshot.py --report           read only: how long each block is and what would be shrunk now (for the nightly report)

Phase 2 (people moved into the event store; on when memory/archive/retired-20261103/<owner>.md exists): the owner's sections
come from ledger/people/<owner>.md that hhd exports, people lately from ledger/people/near.md (midterm.py), and a guest
snapshot carries the guest's own ledger/people/<id>.md; when it is off, everything is as before.

MEMORY.md is injected once: when the root MEMORY.md loads normally, the snapshot keeps only a pointer to it.
When too long it shrinks, in this order: the part of <owner>.md over its target -> open loops untouched for two weeks ->
the MEMORY copy -> the timeline keeps only today -> the midterm window last; each step writes a line in the snapshot.

digestHelp:
The material for the night's consolidation: the raw records of the role's day (4:00 to 4:00 the next day) put together for the consolidating session to read.

  sleep_digest.py pending [--no-write]      the days not consolidated yet, from the earliest, one per line (nothing when there are none).
                                             A day with nothing at all (no messages, no notes, no new log lines) is marked
                                             consolidated right away (state.json's empty) and not listed; --no-write only looks.
  sleep_digest.py YYYY-MM-DD                make the material of that day: sleep/<day>/input.md and sources.json; print the size of each part
  sleep_digest.py done YYYY-MM-DD           note that the day is consolidated. Refused before that day's night (2:00 the next morning);
                                             refused, with a deferral noted, when the material is incomplete; a day deferred two nights
                                             already is marked done on the third night anyway, with state.json's deferred saying so
  sleep_digest.py defer YYYY-MM-DD reason   note one deferral only (power saving, say); not marked done
For tests: --root DIR (the material and state.json under DIR's sleep/), --ws DIR (read the sources from another workspace),
  --db PATH (the old agent's conversation database), --honcho URL (only for the coverage), --now TIME (pretend it is that time; only with --root).
Exit codes: 0 fine; 3 the material is incomplete (input.md is written anyway, line 2 says what is missing), or done refused for that; 2 usage error or refused.

"The last day to consolidate": run before 4:00 it is the day now ending; run after 4:00, the day before (for a late run at 5:30).

The start of input.md: line 1 a title; line 2 always "Material: complete" or "Material: incomplete (missing: …)"; then the capture coverage, notes and the legend of source tags.
Contents: 1. each person's conversations (their own words); 1b. facts in today's ledger the conversations don't have; 2. the main session's
daily notes and the day's compaction summaries; 3. the role's own day; 3b. (phase 2, only when there are any) what went into retired files by mistake;
4. threads; 5. the timeline; 6. open loops in progress; 6b. threads that slid out of the midterm window; 7. the midterm memory now;
8. learning (the check's verdicts of the night before; the weekly numbers on Sunday or when the backtest got worse); 9. errors.
Every part carries its source tag; # headings inside the material become ＃; values such as passwords and codes are masked with redact.py.
sleep/<day>/sources.json gets the sha256 of every memory source file at that moment (sleep_apply.py checks against it).

lintHelp:
The night's mechanical check (no language model; report only for now).

  memory_lint.py <day> [--report] [--all] [--base-rev REV] [--no-raw-db] [--root WS] [--day-dir DIR]

Checks the consolidation's proposals in sleep/<day>/proposed/ (and sunday-merge/ if there is one, reported apart) against the original
files (with --base-rev, the version in that git commit):

1. Fact lines (only changed lines; --all checks all of them)
   The resident fact lines: threads' one line / summary / status, me these two days, people lately, <owner>.md, story, soul/80, people files.
   The dates, times, numbers with units, names and quotes of each line must be found in a source:
     - thread summaries: first this thread's log; only in its causes or in the material / raw records / ledger is ⚠️; nowhere
       (or only in the consolidation's own meta, summary or status) is ❌.
     - other files: found in the material (input.md) or the raw records passes; only in the ledger is ⚠️; nowhere is ❌.
     - log lines added tonight must themselves be found in the material / raw records.
   Also: the speaker of a quote must be who said it in the records; a fact whose sources all hedge must not be written as certain (⚠️).
2. Invariants
   1. The log only grows; no repeated lines tonight.  2. Every line deleted from a resident file is found somewhere else.
   3. What the report lists as unsure is not written as fact elsewhere.  4. The good-and-bad examples are untouched and appear once.
   5. A changed core personality block has a new soul-changelog line.  6. Without new log lines, a thread's summaries don't change.
   7. Past weeks of the story don't change; only corrections are added at the end.  8. Sizes and counts are counted by the script.
Phase 2 (people in the event store): the people files of the ledger are replaced by the cards hhd exports (ledger/people/*.md).
Result: with --report, <day>/lint.json, and a summary at the top of report.md (<!-- lint:start --> … <!-- lint:end -->, replaced on a rerun).
Report only: exit 0 even with findings; 1 only when the script itself fails.

applyHelp:
Applying the night's consolidation: the consolidating session writes changed files under sleep/<day>/proposed/; this swaps them into the
originals safely by hash and commits them separately. No language model; mechanical work only.

  sleep_apply.py gate                         step 0: look at the quota; print go / defer (no consolidation this run; back at 05:30) / save (power saving: the first steps only, nothing applied or marked done)
  sleep_apply.py begin <day>                  step 0: record the fingerprints of the sensitive places; commit the role's uncommitted daytime changes as day/<day>;
                                              print progress and files deferred before; a last run that did only part starts a new round
  sleep_apply.py material <day>               after digest: full (do everything) / partial (incomplete material: only the steps that don't need the conversations) /
                                              redigest (no material in the new form yet: run digest first)
  sleep_apply.py step <day> <step> [status]   record a step's progress (state.json's steps, done by default); a rerun skips what is done
  sleep_apply.py steps <day>                  show the progress
  sleep_apply.py plan <day>                   a rehearsal: what would be applied / deferred / refused / left for the role; changes nothing
  sleep_apply.py finish <day> [--partial]     step 10: live applies + rebuilds + commits memory and personality separately + marks done; draft rehearses + commits + marks done;
                                              --partial (the run with incomplete material): applies and commits but does not mark done
  sleep_apply.py carry-diff <day> <file>      a file deferred before: what that night wanted to change (the original then → the proposal then)
  sleep_apply.py memory-merge <day>           write memory-merge.md: the changes to MEMORY.md / USER.md, for the role to make itself in a clean round
  sleep_apply.py soul-week <day>              on Sunday: this week's soul-changelog + the real git changes to soul/ (who changed what, by commit) + tonight's proposals
  sleep_apply.py restart <day>                redo a day by hand: the old proposals move into cycle-<n>/, progress starts again

Let through or roll back by hand (for the owner or Claude Code, not the consolidating session):
  sleep_apply.py approve <day> <file>...      approve these proposals: their sha goes into sleep/<day>/approved.json; finish then skips the shrink guard and
                                              the personality cap for them (a proposal changed afterwards no longer counts as approved)
  sleep_apply.py promote <day> <file>...      swap in now proposals of a finished day that were deferred: the original must still be as at digest (the
                                              hash in sources.json), or it is refused; rebuilds, commits only these files, writes last_applied_at
  sleep_apply.py rollback <day> [--soul|--memory]  git revert that night's tagged commits (newest first), rebuild, write last_applied_at;
                                              refused when the files those commits touched have uncommitted changes

Rules:
- A proposal overwrites the original only when the original's sha256 now equals the one in sleep/<day>/sources.json (at digest);
  otherwise it is deferred: untouched this night, written into the report, redone next night on the new original.
- MEMORY.md and USER.md are never written by the script; their changes go into memory-merge.md for the role to make itself.
- SOUL.md and memory/recent.md are generated: after applying, soul_build.py, midterm.py build and ledger_snapshot.py run again.
- Only .md under memory/, soul/ and skills/, and sleep/soul-changelog.md (appended by line), are taken; a proposal anywhere else means
  the consolidation went wrong: nothing is applied that night.
- Shrink guard: a memory or personality proposal with over 25% fewer content lines than the original is deferred until someone looks
  and approves / promotes; for threads only the log (经过) counts: every old log line must still be there.
- The notebook's gate: skills/ proposals must lose no lines and no ids HH knows; otherwise all skills/ proposals are deferred that night.
- Fingerprints: what begin recorded is compared at finish; a change, memory files written outside sleep/<day>/, or personality / people
  files changed during consolidation means nothing is applied that night (exit code 2).
- Commits: day/<day> at begin, then sleep/<day>/memory and sleep/<day>/soul at finish, each tagged; only when all succeed is
  sleep_digest.py done <day> run and last_applied_at written.
Exit codes: 0 done; 2 refused or failed (see the report); 3 another consolidation is applying.
